references.label: Top multiplier lanes
references.description: Four top lanes collected in order from 2x through 5x.

references.label: Right return lane
references.description: Lower lane that advances the active Bonus X sequence.

references.label: Upper-left Collect Bonus saucer
references.description: Collects and resets base bonus while preserving Bonus X for the ball.

references.label: Lower-right Extra Bonus saucer
references.description: Adds multiple base-bonus advances before ejecting toward the left flipper.

references.label: Top-right gate
references.description: Right-side route back to the top lanes and plunge area.
